outlook.discussion: 1. Well East-Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands (EP91): Showers and thunderstorms are limited and disorganized in association with an area of low pressure located well east-southeast of the Hawaiian Islands. Although the system has lost some organization today, it is still expected to become a tropical depression during the next day or two while it drifts northeastward. Environmental conditions are expected to become less conducive for development late this week. Formation chance through 48 hours...high...90 percent. Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.
